title: Infant Formula Organic Powder (Made with Water)

content.title: About
content.content: Organic infant formula in powder form is designed to be prepared with water. It contains carefully selected ingredients such as whole cow's milk, plant proteins, vitamins and minerals that meet infants' nutritional needs. The product is certified to international quality standards and contains no GMOs, artificial colors or flavors.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The formula is made from organic ingredients grown without synthetic pesticides.
Each batch undergoes strict microbiological testing.
Developed according to WHO and national pediatric guidelines.
Packaged in recyclable material to reduce environmental impact.
The powder dissolves easily in water, creating a smooth, nutritious feed.

items.title: Supports growth and development
items.content: A balanced mix of proteins, fats and carbohydrates provides essential amino acids and energy for rapid infant growth.

items.title: Rich source of vitamins and minerals
items.content: Includes vitamin D, calcium, iron and zinc, which support bone development, immunity and nervous system function.

items.title: Promotes digestive health
items.content: Contains pre‑biotics and probiotics that foster a healthy gut microbiome.

items.title: Low allergen profile
items.content: Free from soy, gluten and lactose in free form, making the formula more hypoallergenic.

items.title: Environmental friendliness
items.content: Organic production reduces environmental impact and preserves biodiversity.

items.title: Cow's milk protein allergy
items.content: Children with known cow's milk allergy should consult a pediatrician before use.

items.title: Incorrect reconstitution
items.content: Follow the recommended water‑to‑powder ratio to avoid hyper‑ or hypoglycemia.

items.title: Post‑opening storage
items.content: After opening, keep the container in a dry place and use within the indicated period.

items.title: Water quality control
items.content: Use safe drinking water for preparation to prevent microbial contamination.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: Measure the specified amount of powder, add it to boiled (or cooled to 40 °C) water, stir thoroughly until fully dissolved. Allow the mixture to cool to body temperature before feeding.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the package in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, seal tightly. Discard the product if it develops an off‑odor, color change, or clumps.
